description: Deterministic basic Solaris setup: geo -> dome light -> materials -> camera -> render settings. Linear chain in /stage, exact names, explicit wires and positions. The noun 'basic Solaris setup' resolves to THIS file.

ownership.note: Reconciler concern. The verify probe does not create the box; boxes have zero effect on composed USD.

provenance.epistemics: Node types and parm NAMES are probe-verified against build 22.0.368. Parm VALUES and prim path conventions are design choices.

baseline.note: The two builds behind this hash were made under two DIFFERENT $HIP values (this worktree and the main working tree) and agreed byte-for-byte. That is the point of c3 and it is pinned as invariant F-6, with C-6 showing the same two builds disagreeing under c2. Unlike the c2 baseline below, this number does not pin the machine or the launch directory.

superseded_baselines.reason: MACHINE-LOCAL. karmarendersettings authors $HIP/render/$HIPNAME.$OS.$F4.exr, which reaches the composed stage already EXPANDED, so this hash pinned the directory it was cut in (C:/Users/User/SYNAPSE) rather than the fixture. Finding M5-F1. c3 adds rule 5, normalize_houdini_env_paths, which rewrites environment-derived absolute paths back to their variable token; a canonicalizer rule change is a re-baseline event for every fixture, so the number moved. Reproducible: this exact sha256 is still emitted by the c3 producer as the 'c2' hash when built under $HIP=C:/Users/User/SYNAPSE - see harness/blocks/runs/m5b_baseline_cut/baseline_c3.json, builds.b.c2.

queued_v1_1.lighting_law: intensity stays 1.0; brightness via exposure only. Verified encoded names: xn__inputsexposure_control_wcb (set to 'set'), xn__inputsexposure_vya (stops value).
queued_v1_1.resolution_pins: karmarendersettings resolutionx / resolutiony verified; values are a product decision.
